findings.current: The shockwave reached out hundreds, even thousands of kilometers, shaking the world beyond the rectangular screen.
findings.defect: “Shockwave” turns a far-reaching reverberation into a physical blast wave.
findings.rationale: 울림 denotes a reverberation, not a shockwave.
findings.replacement: The reverberation carried hundreds, even thousands of kilometers, shaking the world beyond the rectangular screen.
findings.source: 수백, 수천 킬로미터 밖으로 뻗어 나간 울림은 직사각형의 화면을 넘어 세상을 뒤흔들었다.

findings.current: Unlike a God so distant that his voice could not reach them, the savior of the new age answered their desperate pleas before long.
findings.defect: The direction of the unheard voice is reversed.
findings.rationale: The contrast is between a distant God who cannot hear their pleas and a savior who answers them.
findings.replacement: Unlike God, who was so far away that their voices could not reach him, the savior of the new age answered their desperate pleas before long.
findings.source: 그리고 너무나도 먼 곳에 있어 목소리조차 닿지 않는 신과 달리, 새로운 시대의 구원자는 오래 지나지 않아 그 간절함에 응답했다.

findings.defect: The question asks for deaths alone rather than casualties.
findings.rationale: 사상자 includes the dead and the injured; Johnson only subsequently reports that there are no signs of life.

findings.current: Soon, some amazing guy’s gonna come looking for you and ask your name. Your name, your—
findings.defect: Pie Chen says the visitor will ask about her name, not Morgoth’s.
findings.rationale: 그 이름 refers back to the name Pie Chen has just insisted Morgoth remember.
findings.replacement: Soon, some amazing guy’s gonna come looking for you and ask about that name. Ask about my name, my—
findings.source: 조만간 어떤 대단한 녀석이 널 찾아와서 그 이름을, 이름을 물어, 볼…….

findings.defect: The draft omits that his remaining arm is his right arm.
findings.rationale: 오른팔 specifies the right arm, a physical continuity detail.
findings.replacement: With his right arm—the only one he had left.

findings.current: “From now on, I won’t let anyone else die.”
findings.defect: The promise narrows preventing further sacrifice to preventing deaths.
findings.rationale: 희생하게 두진 않겠다 is a promise not to let anyone else be sacrificed, echoing Pie Chen’s sacrifice.
findings.replacement: “From now on, I won’t let anyone else be sacrificed.”
findings.source: “지금부터, 그 누구도 희생하게 두진 않을 겁니다.”

summary: The draft changes two consequential details in Pie Chen’s final exchange and loses several physical and causal details.
